notablePrerequisites:
Ioreth and Clever Conjurer do not have summoning sickness.
There is another legendary creature on the battlefield.
description:
If Clever Conjurer is not your Ring-bearer, use the card that causes the Ring to tempt you to cause Clever Conjurer to become your Ring-bearer, thus making it legendary.
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Clever Conjurer and another legendary creature.
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, untapping Ioreth.
Repeat from step 2.
